[Observable in enhanced video] Labissiere (SAC) moves his pivot foot.
Cauley-Stein (SAC) sets the screen on Lamb (CHA) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Bogdanovic (SAC) cleanly deflects the ball away from Batum (CHA).
After communicating with the Replay Center, the ruling on the floor of Kings possession is confirmed.
Fox (SAC) clamps the arm of Howard (CHA), affecting his ability to retrieve the rebound.
Lamb (CHA) legally contests Hield's (SAC) jump shot attempt.
Williams (CHA) makes clean contact with the ball before making incidental arm contact with Cauley-Stein (SAC).
After communicating with the Replay Center, the ruling on the floor of Kings possession is overturned to Hornets possession.
Howard (CHA) sets the screen on Fox (SAC) and gives him room to avoid the contact.

Cauley-Stein (SAC) blocks the ball after it makes contact with the backboard and still has a chance to score.
[Observable in enhanced video] Labissiere (SAC) moves his pivot foot heel to toe.
Lamb (CHA) legally contests Fox's (SAC) jump shot attempt.
Howard (CHA) makes marginal contact with Labissiere (SAC) during his follow-through that does not affect his shot attempt.
Hield (SAC) commits a take foul on Walker (CHA).
Batum (CHA) and Bogdanovic (SAC) briefly engage and separate during the inbound.
Fox (SAC) enters the area inside the three-point line prior to the release on the free throw.
